download.text: About 68.5 GB to download: the model (66.4 GB), the picture reader (0.9 GB) and the DFlash2 drafter (1.2 GB). To skip the picture reader (the model then answers text only), add --vision off; or put its mmproj file next to your model files. To skip the DFlash2 drafter, add --drafting mtp.
